core.notes:
Nunito (rounded) is now everyone's number font; this update switches it once, and you can pick another in Settings › Fonts
Settings › Fonts: Nunito and Quicksand are now text fonts too
Right-click menus with ticks can stay open while you change several options
Settings › Fonts: three more number fonts, all narrower than the default and with a plain zero: Barlow Semi Condensed (narrow), Nunito (rounded) and Quicksand (rounded, narrow)
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: shares the board it reads with the new Grid Builder (nothing changes on the overlay itself)
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: everyone gets the new standard look once with this update (numbers on, soft mod colours, cleaner tiles with the overlay on, presets beside the grid, 1 decimal); your start view and grid size are kept
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: the right-click menu on "Overlay on" stays open while you change things, has a Size row (80% to 120%) above Decimals, and a "Show all settings" button
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: new setting "Font on the tiles": Auto follows Settings › Fonts (Quicksand when you show 3 decimals), or pick one font for the tiles
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: the separate Relative number view is gone; the tiles always show their percentages or item levels
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: choose 0, 1, 2 or 3 decimals for the numbers on the tiles, at the bottom of the right-click menu on "Overlay on" (also in settings), and a "Numbers on the tiles" setting to show or hide them
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: new defaults for everyone: names only, soft mod colours, cleaner grid tiles and presets beside the grid are on; uniques in one colour and the tile pop-up are off
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: "Cleaner grid tiles" is now two settings, one for the overlay on (on by default) and one for the game's normal grid with the overlay off (off by default); the tiles are bigger with much less empty space between the sculptures
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: new option "Unique visuals" (off by default, in settings and the right-click menu): coloured grid lines around a resonator's row, a channeler's column and the tiles around a cornerstone, also with the overlay off
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: the numbers on the tiles are lighter and use your AWOO+ number font
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: shorter pop-ups: a preset just says "Right-click for more", and a tile's pop-up shows only its roll and its item level
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: tiles are easier to read: "Relic" instead of "BASE REL", mod names in normal letters, rolls with one decimal (22,2%), and a unique's tag in the tile's corner instead of on its own line
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: right-click the grid to hide the numbers and show only the mod names (right-click again to bring them back); right-click "Overlay on" for quick settings
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: with "Cleaner grid tiles" on, the game's own frame around each sculpture steps aside while the overlay is on (only the selected one keeps it), so frames no longer overlap
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: the presets list beside the grid is a bit wider, has a Set Active button, and right-click on a preset gives Set Active, Rename, New, Reset and Delete (they use the game's own buttons and dialogs); while the active preset switches it shows a dashed, pulsing "busy" look, and it no longer flickers when you switch presets
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay settings (Modules › Tweaks › Sculpture Grid Overlay): "Soft mod colours on the tiles" puts a light wash of each mod's colour behind it; "Uniques in one colour" shows every unique sculpture in the same orange-red; "Cleaner grid tiles" (on) gives the game's own tiles quieter borders, a darker ground and a clear hover; "Grid size" makes the whole grid smaller or larger (60% to 150%); "Presets beside the grid" shows your presets as a narrow list left of the grid, click one to show it (renaming, Set Active and New stay in the game's Presets tab)
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: the pop-up when hovering a tile is gone by default (it can be turned back on in its settings)
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: a swap shows sooner (the overlay checks quickly right after you drop or click), and nothing of the overlay runs while you are dragging a sculpture, so dragging feels smoother
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: easier to read. Each labelled tile has its own dark background, the number is bright white and bold, and the mod name above it has one fixed colour per kind of mod (relics gold, Description teal, other recipes blue, XP violet, stats red, gold and drop green, resources tan), so a mod no longer changes colour when you swap sculptures. Unique sculptures keep their colour as border, a light tint and a small filled tag; tiles an Obelisk reaches get a dashed pink outline
Sculpture Grid Overlay: Grid Overlay: much lighter on your computer. It only re-reads the grid when the game actually changed it (a swap, a tile upgrade, a preset change) instead of on every change anywhere on the page, so swaps still show at once
